h3.button: 1. Is the 3-Hour Strategic Architecture Workshop genuinely free of charge or obligations?

div.div: Yes, 100% complimentary with zero commercial or contractual obligation. At INNORIA, we believe institutional trust is earned through high-caliber architectural depth before any commercial agreement. If you determine our platform or services are not the right fit, the architectural artifacts and roadmap generated during the session remain yours to keep.

h3.button: 2. How and when is the Enterprise Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) executed?

div.div: Our standard bilateral enterprise NDA is automatically countersigned and transmitted within 2 business hours of your intake submission. We are equally pleased to review and execute your organization's internal corporate NDA. All strategic discussions, existing architecture diagrams, and business telemetry shared during the engagement are strictly protected under Vietnamese and international trade secret laws.

h3.button: 3. How does INNORIA guarantee zero proprietary vendor lock-in?

div.div: Zero lock-in is a core foundational architectural invariant. All solutions built on DIGIFORCE, MOJO AI, MOJOVERSE, or custom microservices compile into standard containerized workloads (Docker / Kubernetes / standard PostgreSQL schemas). You own 100% of your business logic, custom AI fine-tunes, and data schemas. You can self-host on-premise, deploy on sovereign private cloud (Viettel, VNPT, FPT), or run on AWS/GCP/Azure with full code portability.
